f_01KXA5CGPJRE16ZSJ1Y68334DT.subject: scheduled_start_date
f_01KXA5CGPJRE16ZSJ1Y68334DT.content: The job is scheduled to start on 2026-10-05.

f_01KXA5CGPK4V0V2ZBQF7JXZYK2.subject: addition_footprint_and_program
f_01KXA5CGPK4V0V2ZBQF7JXZYK2.content: The addition is a two-story, 30' x 10' structure providing basement-level storage and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXA5CGPKD5TQWVBQPJRNSF11.subject: septic_requirement
f_01KXA5CGPKD5TQWVBQPJRNSF11.content: The scope document requires a TDEC septic inspection and feasibility determination (relocate, new tank/leach field, or grinder pump) as a pre-construction action; septic relocation/replacement costs are explicitly excluded and would require a change order.

f_01KXA5CGPKDCA4FXN3E828HN9W.subject: lvl_beam_scope
f_01KXA5CGPKDCA4FXN3E828HN9W.content: Structural scope includes one (1) 3-ply 14" engineered LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6".

f_01KXA5CGPKGYA7K6ZSHAAAPMEG.subject: roof_tie_in_pitch
f_01KXA5CGPKGYA7K6ZSHAAAPMEG.content: The new 3/12 pitch roof ties into the existing 6/12 pitch roof.

f_01KXA5CGPK07KKKDTBNBZZ474S.subject: subpanel_scope
f_01KXA5CGPK07KKKDTBNBZZ474S.content: Electrical scope includes a new 100-amp subpanel; the scope document lists 'existing electrical service can support new subpanel' as an assumption, not a verified finding.

f_01KXA5CGPKN3Q2HD1R7BB82QQQ.subject: windows_scope
f_01KXA5CGPKN3Q2HD1R7BB82QQQ.content: Window scope includes four (4) windows: three 36" x 60" units and one transom.

f_01KXA5CGPKC44R2AX636C320TK.subject: elevator_shaft_framing
f_01KXA5CGPKC44R2AX636C320TK.content: An approximately 4' x 4' elevator shaft is framed as part of the addition scope; the elevator itself is not included.

f_01KXA5CGPKMQ6GERFN093AZNSD.subject: job_valuation_status
f_01KXA5CGPKMQ6GERFN093AZNSD.content: Job valuation is null; no estimation has been run against this job.

f_01KXA5CGPK4XHRZNZ2VHYMVRAG.subject: exterior_finish_materials
f_01KXA5CGPK4XHRZNZ2VHYMVRAG.content: Exterior finish scope includes architectural asphalt shingle roofing to match existing, vinyl siding to match existing, seamless gutters, fascia board and metal, and vinyl soffit.
